question: Which human chromosome was the subject of the pilot study that preceded the Human Protein Atlas, in what year did that pilot begin, and what question did the founders ask in the 2002 funding proposal?

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"Human Protein Atlas pilot study chromosome founders 2002 funding proposal"}

turns.text:
- **Chromosome:** The pilot study covered **human chromosome 21**. It was initiated in **2000** to investigate all genes encoded by that chromosome. [Human Protein Atlas—“Chromosome 21 pilot”](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/history/2000+Chromosome+21+pilot)

- **Question in the 2002 funding proposal:** The founders asked, **“What is it that makes a kidney a kidney? And what makes a heart a heart?”** They framed this as a question of why cells with the same genetic material acquire different functions through differing active genes and proteins. [Human Protein Atlas—“Start of the Human Protein Atlas program”](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/history/2003+Start+of+the+Human+Protein+Atlas+program)
